Act as the implementation sub-agent for this task.

You are implementing PR 2 of a 6-PR stacked series in Moneo. Follow AGENTS.md exactly (no comments, test rules, QA backend only — never the owner's backend or port 3000, Speed section, screenshots embedded in the PR).

Stacking: PR 1 is https://github.com/indkhan/Moneo/pull/341 on branch `t3/settings-1-connected-accounts` (not merged). First `git fetch origin` and create your branch `t3/settings-2-scalable-holdings` from `origin/t3/settings-1-connected-accounts`. Open your PR with base `t3/settings-1-connected-accounts`.

PR 1 moved the Scalable portfolio (`ScalablePortfolioView`, `components/scalable-portfolio.tsx`) into the Scalable card in the new "Connected" area on `/money/accounts`. Owner's requirement for PR 2: Scalable must still show all its data, and for EACH stock/holding the owner can see:
- a table of how it has gone up and down (dated values / changes, e.g. value, price, change in amount and %, per period),
- a line graph of the holding's value going up and down over time,
- as many details as possible (quantity, average buy price, current price, unrealised gain/loss, trades, etc.).
Use the data Moneo already stores (`scalable_value_history`, `scalable_security_charts`, `scalable_security_trades`, `scalable_trade_details`, the portfolio snapshot in `scalable_connections.portfolio`; see `lib/scalable/`). Reuse existing chart components/libraries in the repo (check what Wealth or home charts use) — no new chart dependency unless none exists. Money stays integer minor units with currency; formatting uses the owner's locale and time zone from Settings. Also add a portfolio-total value line chart if the data supports it. Likely design: each holding row expands (or opens a detail panel) with chart + table; must work on mobile, light and dark. Keep the Accounts page fast: load per-holding history only when a holding is opened (or prove server rendering stays within budget); measure LCP before/after (skill `measure-speed`) and keep the bundle within `npm run check:bundle`. If the stored data lacks history for a holding, say so honestly in the UI instead of inventing points. Check other surfaces where it makes sense (Wealth page, chat tools for Scalable) but don't duplicate features already there — if Wealth already has per-holding charts, reuse that component.

Workflow: commit in steps, messages end with `Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`. Before/after screenshots with skill `verify-ui` (light/dark/mobile, holding collapsed and expanded), seeding mocked Scalable data on QA (never real Scalable calls); clean up seed data after. Run `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build`, `npm run check:bundle`, affected Playwright. Push, open PR titled "Accounts: per-holding table and value chart for Scalable", screenshots embedded (uploaded so they render, as PR 1 did on the `pr-assets` branch), Speed section, Decisions section, body ends with "🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)". Do not merge. Final line: PR <full URL>, head <SHA>, checks and reviews <state>.
